parameters.query:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.project_type, p.location_province, p.location_city,
       p.property_type, p.property_area_m2, p.budget_target, p.urgency, p.current_phase,
       p.metadata
FROM projects p WHERE p.id = $1::uuid LIMIT 1

SELECT id, summary, rooms_affected, client_needs, constraints, open_questions, status
FROM briefings
WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND status = 'approved'
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, title, intervention_logic, rooms_layout, pros, cons
FROM design_options
WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND is_selected = true
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, category, name, brand, supplier, unit_price, unit, quantity_estimated, total_estimated, quality_tier, room_area
FROM material_items
WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND status IN ('approved','suggested')
ORDER BY category, total_estimated DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT category, partida, unit, min_price, avg_price, max_price, source
FROM price_references
ORDER BY category, partida

SELECT directiva, contexto, prioridad FROM architect_directives
WHERE activa = true AND categoria = 'presupuesto'
ORDER BY prioridad DESC LIMIT 10

INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status, started_at, input, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_costs', 'running', now(), $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO cost_estimates (project_id, version, total_estimated, budget_target, deviation_pct, deviation_status, breakdown, adjustments_suggested, scenarios, assumptions, risk_notes, status)
SELECT $1::uuid,
       COALESCE((SELECT MAX(version) FROM cost_estimates WHERE project_id = $1::uuid), 0) + 1,
       $2::numeric, $3::numeric, $4::numeric, $5::text,
       $6::jsonb, $7::jsonb, $8::jsonb, $9::jsonb, $10::text,
       'draft'
RETURNING id, version

UPDATE agent_executions
SET status = 'completed',
    finished_at = now(),
    output = $2::jsonb,
    metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || $3::jsonb
WHERE id = $1::uuid
